ARDUOUS.gloss: characterized by effort to the point of exhaustion
ARDUOUS.definition: Characterized by effort to the point of exhaustion; especially physical effort.
ARDUOUS.example: Worked their arduous way up the mining valley.

ROAD.gloss: an open way for travel or transportation
ROAD.definition: An open way (generally public) for travel or transportation.

SODA.gloss: a sodium salt of carbonic acid
SODA.definition: A sodium salt of carbonic acid; used in making soap powders and glass and paper.

SOAR.example: The dollar soared against the yen.

SAD.gloss: experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness
SAD.definition: Experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness.
SAD.example: Feeling sad because his dog had died.

ROD.gloss: a long thin implement made of metal or wood
ROD.definition: A long thin implement made of metal or wood.

DUO.gloss: two items of the same kind
DUO.definition: Two items of the same kind.

DAS.gloss: any of several small ungulate mammals of Africa and Asia with rodent-like incisors and…
DAS.definition: Any of several small ungulate mammals of Africa and Asia with rodent-like incisors and feet with hooflike toes.
